diagnostics.message: "order.coupon.renamed-away" is not a capability kind this catalog defines. A consumer names either a real capability or null (for a site that is not a capability at all — a subscriber, a session helper). A stale kind here means a renamed capability left the declaration pointing at nothing, and the boot refusal would send an operator to a symbol that no longer exists.
